issues.description: Class constructor signature mismatch for GroverLightsOutPuzzle.__init__: the template (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) declares def __init__(self, initial_state: list[int]) (i.e. requires an initial_state parameter), whereas the solution implementation (solution_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) declares def __init__(self) with no parameters. The problem statement's Exercise 4.1 and the template's run() examples expect instantiation without supplying an initial_state, so the template's required parameter is unused elsewhere and will cause a TypeError if students follow the examples and instantiate GroverLightsOutPuzzle() with no arguments.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template constructor signature consistent with the solution and usage examples. Recommended: change the template constructor to def __init__(self): (remove the unused initial_state parameter) and update any docstring text accordingly so students instantiate GroverLightsOutPuzzle() without arguments. Alternatively (less preferred), update run() and examples to pass an initial_state and ensure the constructor stores it for later use; however, the preferred fix is to remove the unused parameter to match the solution implementation.

issues.description: Concept: where to provide the puzzle initial board (a list[int] representing the lights). Problem statement and solution expect the initial board to be passed to grover_circuit as the parameter named state_of_lights (e.g., grover_circuit(..., state_of_lights=[0,0,1,1])). Template: the GroverLightsOutPuzzle class constructor is declared as __init__(self, initial_state: list[int]) (parameter name initial_state) while the solution and the problem examples use no constructor parameter and instead pass the board to grover_circuit. This mismatch (template constructor expecting initial_state vs. solution/problem passing state_of_lights to grover_circuit) can confuse students about where to supply the puzzle initial state and whether to implement __init__ with that argument or not.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: remove the initial_state parameter from the template's GroverLightsOutPuzzle.__init__ so it matches the solution and the problem examples (i.e., __init__(self) with the initial board supplied to grover_circuit as state_of_lights). Update the template docstring/comments to clarify that the initial board should be provided to state_preparation/grover_circuit via state_of_lights. Alternatively (less preferred), update the solution and problem examples to accept and use initial_state in the constructor — but keep one consistent convention across all artifacts.
